summary: Stage 2A-ii Customer Portal active-workflows frontend smoke test complete. All 5 Post-Job wizard steps work end-to-end for both fixed-price and bidding jobs against the live preview backend: server-side /api/geo/autocomplete is called; manual address fallback commits with no Google Maps browser key; RouteMap SVG renders with route-preview; /api/quote/estimate is called live; step-3 date gating works; /api/catalog/recommend-vehicle is called for 'Not Sure' and 6 vehicles render; pricing-bidding-tab / pricing-fixed-tab toggle; /api/booking-fees/preview is called live and populates booking fee £25 + total £225 correctly for a £200 driver charge; POST /api/jobs succeeds and navigates to /customer/job/{id}. Job detail shows fixed-waiting for fixed-price posted job and bids-empty for bidding posted job; RouteMap renders. BookingDetail unpaid state renders booking-summary, deposit-locked-notice, pay-deposit-button; not-found state also handled. RBAC: unauth /customer/post-job redirects to /auth/login?next=%2Fcustomer%2Fpost-job. Session restoration via HttpOnly cookie works on reload; no JWT in localStorage/sessionStorage (only PostHog analytics keys). Zero requests to maps.googleapis.com (6 google hits were all fonts.googleapis.com Inter font stylesheet). No AIzaSy key exposed in DOM. Regression: /customer dashboard, /customer/bookings, /customer/messages, /customer/profile all load without errors.

ui_bugs.issue: payment-polling banner is unreachable when the booking id is invalid: the early 'Booking not found.' return at line ~189 renders before the polling banner (line ~230) can be shown. On the happy path (valid booking) this is fine, but a customer returning from Stripe to a booking whose GET fails (e.g. transient 5xx) will never see the 'Confirming your Stripe payment…' banner even though the polling useEffect is running.

When /api/geo/autocomplete returns zero suggestions and the user goes through manual entry, the committed address has lat=0, lng=0 (no client-side geocode). PostJob then calls /api/quote/estimate with pickup_lat=0&pickup_lng=0 and submits the job with pickup_lat=0. Backend currently accepts it, but the resulting quote/RouteMap is geographically meaningless. Consider a server-side geocode step on commit (POST /api/geo/geocode) or block submit when lat/lng are 0.

action_items: (MEDIUM) Geocode manual address commits server-side so pickup_lat/lng and dropoff_lat/lng aren't 0 — otherwise /api/quote/estimate and the persisted job carry (0,0) coordinates.
(LOW) Move the payment-polling banner above the 'Booking not found' early-return in BookingDetail so Stripe returns still show the confirmation state even if the initial GET failed.
critical_code_review_comments: PostJob.jsx submit(): pickup.lat/lng may be 0 when suggestions returned nothing and user went manual — backend accepts but quote & map are meaningless. Recommend forcing at least a postcode-level geocode before commit.
BookingDetail.jsx line ~189: the not-found early return short-circuits payment-polling and paid-tabs UI. Consider rendering the header + payment-polling banner regardless of booking presence.
PostJob step-1 canNext1 = category + title trim only — description is optional (matches spec).
PostJob step-5 canSubmit only checks fixed_price>0 in fixed mode; bidding mode always submittable — matches spec.
acceptBid in JobDetail.jsx uses alert() for error surfacing — consider a toast/inline error for consistency with the rest of the portal.

AddressAutocomplete: pickSuggestion() does not carry through place_id/lat/lng from the /api/geo/autocomplete response into the form (only formatted_address + town). If the server returns lat/lng in suggestions they are dropped.
